leadText:
Chopper (Japanese: マサ Masa) is a character of the day who appeared in The Bridge Bike Gang. He is a member of a gang who have claimed Cycling Road as their territory. They s who are traveling across the bridge.

Chopper and Tyra, another biker, are old friends of Jessie and James, as they were members of the bike gang before they decided to join Team Rocket.

Chopper entered into a battle with , and while his was able to defeat his , it was defeated by Ash's Charmander. After the battle, Ash and continued across the bridge to Sunnytown, attempting to deliver medicine to a sick . However, Chopper and the other bikers stopped them, wanting to battle. When Ash declined, saying he was trying to deliver medicine to a sick Pokémon, Chopper was impressed that Ash would brave dangerous weather to help a Pokémon. He and the other bikers escorted the kids to the Pokémon Center. Chopper, impressed with Ash's bravery, announced that the gang would dub him "Awesome Ash".
